purpose: Declares which baseline facts the rollback play must restore, and which captured artefacts are excluded from hash comparison because they are not reproducible on an unmodified host.
determined_by: Empirical test: each artefact was captured twice on an unmodified host and the SHA-256 values compared. Evidence in sysctl-volatility-evidence.txt and listeners-volatility-evidence.txt.

excluded_from_hash_comparison.reason: Contains kernel counters and a per-read random value, so two captures of an unmodified host never produce the same hash.
excluded_from_hash_comparison.comparison_used_instead: Only the specific sysctl keys the hardening role changes are read individually and compared by value.

excluded_from_hash_comparison.reason: ss -tulpn embeds process IDs and file descriptors per socket. These change on every process restart and on every reboot, including the snapshot restore performed during the unattended lifecycle.
excluded_from_hash_comparison.comparison_used_instead: Projection to protocol and address:port, sorted. PID and fd fields are discarded before comparison.

note_on_port_80: nginx listens on both 80 and 8080 at baseline. Only 8080 is named in service-contract.yml. Port 80 is recorded so that a later remediation closing it is identified as a deliberate change rather than an undetected regression.
